claims.claim: The US military announced on Wednesday that it completed the withdrawal of all American troops from Iraq, ending a 12-year mission against the Islamic State.
claims.episode_span: the US military said on Wednesday that it has completed the withdrawal of all American troops, ending a twelve-year mission against the Islamic State group
claims.source_title: Mixed reactions in Iraq on final day of US-led coalition withdrawal
claims.supporting_quote: The US military announced on Wednesday that it has completed the withdrawal of all American troops from Iraq, ending a 12-year mission to fight the Islamic State group.

claims.claim: The last US troops left an air base in northern Iraq under a deal between Baghdad and Washington.
claims.episode_span: The last US troops left an air base in northern Iraq under a deal between Baghdad and Washington.
claims.source_title: Mixed reactions in Iraq on final day of US-led coalition withdrawal
claims.supporting_quote: The last US troops left an air base in northern Iraq under a deal between Baghdad and Washington.

claims.claim: Iraq's leaders celebrated the end of the US-led coalition mission, while some fear it will embolden pro-Iran armed factions.
claims.episode_span: the country's leaders celebrated the close of a US-led coalition mission
claims.source_title: Why is the US withdrawing its troops from Iraq?
claims.supporting_quote: A US-led coalition deployed in Iraq more than a decade ago to fight jihadists concluded its mission on Wednesday, a move celebrated by the country's leaders, but which some fear will embolden pro-Iran armed factions.

claims.claim: Prime Minister Andy Burnham told Labour's Liverpool conference that the Conservative Brexit settlement had done more harm than good and said he would set out options at a UK-EU summit later this year.
claims.episode_span: Prime Minister Andy Burnham told Labour's conference in Liverpool on Tuesday that the Brexit settlement struck by the Conservatives had done more harm than good
claims.source_title: UK’s Burnham says he’ll consider push to rejoin EU
claims.supporting_quote: Burnham told the governing Labour Party’s annual conference in Liverpool Tuesday that the Brexit settlement struck by the Conservatives had done “more harm than good” and said he would spell out “what I believe the different options are for Britain’s long-term relationship with our European partners” at a U.K.–EU summit later this year.

claims.claim: Burnham said Britain could look at a customs union, the single market, or going all the way, and weigh what is doable and the pros and cons.
claims.episode_span: the government could look at a customs union, as former chancellor George Osborne has suggested, at the single market, as the Liberal Democrats have argued, or could go all the way
claims.source_title: UK’s Burnham says he’ll consider push to rejoin EU
claims.supporting_quote: Burnham said: “We could look at what [former Chancellor] George Osborne has said about a customs union, we could look at what the Liberal Democrats said at their conference about the single market, or we could go all the way.”

claims.claim: Burnham's government will stick before a general election to Keir Starmer's promise not to rejoin the single market or customs union.
claims.episode_span: his government will stick, before a general election, to predecessor Keir Starmer's promise not to rejoin the single market or the customs union
claims.source_title: UK’s Burnham says he’ll consider push to rejoin EU
claims.supporting_quote: Burnham’s Labour predecessor, Keir Starmer, had promised not to rejoin the EU’s single market or customs union. Burnham’s government will stick to that position before a general election

claims.claim: Conservative deputy leader Alex Burghart said Burnham cannot be trusted and is dragging Britain back into Brexit arguments.
claims.episode_span: Alex Burghart said Burnham cannot be trusted and is dragging Britain back into Brexit arguments
claims.source_title: UK’s Burnham says he’ll consider push to rejoin EU
claims.supporting_quote: Deputy Leader Alex Burghart said: “You cannot trust a word Andy Burnham says. Just a few weeks ago he said he wanted to move on from the Brexit arguments and now he is dragging Britain back into them by floating the prospect of rejoining the EU."

claims.claim: The US Supreme Court's six-justice conservative majority allowed third-country deportations to resume without a chance to contest removal or claim fear of torture.
claims.episode_span: the Supreme Court has ruled the Trump administration can resume deporting immigrants to countries other than their homeland without a chance to contest the removal
claims.source_title: ‘Third country’ deportation can resume, US supreme court rules | First Thing
claims.supporting_quote: The supreme court has ruled the Trump administration can resume deporting immigrants to “third countries” , or countries other than their homeland, without giving them any opportunity to contest their removals.

claims.claim: A flydubai flight from Dubai to Israel diverted to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, after three emergency signals over Jordan, one indicating possible unlawful interference, and dropped about 16,000 feet in two minutes.
claims.episode_span: a flydubai flight from Dubai in the United Arab Emirates to Israel diverted to Tabuk in Saudi Arabia after transmitting three emergency signals over Jordan
claims.source_title: Israel-bound passenger plane makes emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after reported fight between pilots
claims.supporting_quote: The flydubai flight was over Jordan when it diverted to Saudi Arabia , transmitting three emergency signals, one of which indicated a possible unlawful interference.

claims.claim: Israeli officials scrambled fighter jets and the plane landed at Tabuk; the prime minister's office first said it was not a hijack, then authorities said they were investigating.
claims.episode_span: Israeli officials scrambled fighter jets, and the plane landed at Tabuk
claims.source_title: Israel-bound passenger plane makes emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after reported fight between pilots
claims.supporting_quote: Israeli officials scrambled fighter jets, fearful of a possible hijacking attempt on a plane containing dozens of Israelis, and the plane landed at Tabuk airport in north-western Saudi Arabia.

claims.claim: The Israeli government believes the incident may have been an attempted terror attack by one of the pilots.
claims.episode_span: the Israeli government believes one of the pilots may have attempted a terror attack
claims.source_title: Forced landing of Israel-bound flight: What we know so far
claims.supporting_quote: The Israeli government believes an incident on a flight from the United Arab Emirates to Israel, which diverted to Saudi Arabia after transmitting emergency signals on Wednesday, may have been an attempted "terror attack" by one of the pilots.

claims.claim: A passenger told the Jerusalem Post one pilot stabbed another; the Guardian said that could not immediately be verified. A Saudi aviation authority said all passengers were safe and both pilots were hospitalized.
claims.episode_span: A passenger told the Jerusalem Post that one pilot stabbed the other; the Guardian said that account could not immediately be verified.
claims.source_title: Israel-bound passenger plane makes emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after reported fight between pilots
claims.supporting_quote: A passenger told the Jerusalem Post that one pilot stabbed another and tried to force him out of the cockpit, prompting other Israelis to rush into the cockpit and subdue the attacker as the plane began to plunge.

claims.claim: India's CAFE-3 norms run from April 1, 2027, to March 31, 2032, and tighten fuel use from 3.996 to 3.3273 litres per 100 km, about 16.7 percent.
claims.episode_span: the fuel-consumption benchmark tightens from 3.996 litres per 100 km in 2027-28 to 3.3273 litres per 100 km in 2031-32, about a 16.7 percent improvement
claims.source_title: Government notifies new CAFE-3 norms for passenger vehicles
claims.supporting_quote: Under the new norms, the fuel-consumption benchmark will be tightened from 3.996 litres per 100 km in 2027–28 to 3.3273 litres per 100 km in 2031–32, amounting to an improvement of about 16.7% over the five-year period.

claims.claim: CAFE-3 raises the reference weight from 1,082 kg to 1,229 kg and caps technology concessions at 9.0 g CO2/km.
claims.episode_span: raise the reference weight from 1,082 kg to 1,229 kg
claims.source_title: Government notifies new CAFE-3 norms for passenger vehicles
claims.supporting_quote: The reference weight has been raised from 1,082 kg under the existing norms to 1,229 kg under the new framework, which is an increase of around 13.6 per cent, reflecting the shift towards heavier vehicles in the passenger car segment.

claims.claim: Aliko Dangote and Kenya's President William Ruto broke ground on a $16 billion refinery expected to process 700,000 barrels a day, amid land protests.
claims.episode_span: Dangote and President Ruto broke ground on a sixteen-billion-dollar refinery for seven hundred thousand barrels a day despite land protests
claims.source_title: Africa's richest man launches Kenya oil refinery despite land protests
claims.supporting_quote: Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote and Kenya's President William Ruto have broken ground on a $16bn (Â£12bn) oil refinery in Lamu, on Kenya's northern coast.

claims.claim: UAE Super 98 petrol rises to Dh4.40 a litre in October, up 15.7 percent, a third consecutive monthly increase.
claims.episode_span: October fuel prices rise for a third month, Super 98 to 4.40 dirhams, about sixteen percent
claims.source_title: UAE petrol prices to rise by about 16% in October
claims.supporting_quote: The cost of Super 98 petrol will rise to Dh4.40 a litre, up 15.7 per cent, while Special 95 increases by nearly 16 per cent, at Dh4.28.

claims.claim: From October 1, Azerbaijan's central bank rules delay remote consumer-loan funds by two hours up to twice the minimum wage and by 24 hours above that.
claims.episode_span: the central bank's October 1 rules delay remote consumer loans two hours, or twenty-four above twice the minimum wage
claims.source_title: The Central Bank is changing the rules for issuing online loans
claims.supporting_quote: if the amount of funds issued or increased during the day is up to twice the minimum wage, the money will be issued 2 hours after the conclusion of the agreement or the introduction of amendments. If the amount exceeds twice the minimum wage, the funds will be provided after 24 hours have elapsed.

claims.claim: GSK's Roberta Correa said cabotegravir could enter Brazil's SUS this year if Conitec issues a positive opinion in October.
claims.episode_span: GSK's Roberta Correa said cabotegravir could join the public HIV system this year if Conitec approves in October
claims.source_title: HIV: SUS poderá ter Prep de longa duração ainda neste ano; entenda o que vai mudar
claims.supporting_quote: — Em outubro, vindo um parecer positivo da Conitec (a esfera do Ministério da Saúde que determina qual medicamento fará parte do SUS), fechamos as negociações e faremos o possível para ter o medicamento ainda neste ano — diz Roberta Correa, diretora da unidade de negócios de Virologia da GSK.

claims.claim: Ontario's Protect Ontario account has spent $140 million of $5 billion, including about $40 million on 18 approved applications and $100 million for Algoma steel.
claims.episode_span: the combined outlay at one hundred forty million dollars
claims.source_title: Ford government ‘Protect Ontario’ tariff program spent $140 million so far
claims.supporting_quote: “Eighteen out of those applications have been approved; that represents about $40 million, in addition to the $100 million on Algoma steel support.”

claims.claim: Liberal finance critic Stephanie Bowman said $40 million is 0.01 percent of GDP and the program is not working.
claims.episode_span: She said forty million dollars for Ontario businesses is 0.01 percent of GDP, and that what the government has on offer is not working.
claims.source_title: Ford government ‘Protect Ontario’ tariff program spent $140 million so far
claims.supporting_quote: “Only $40 million in funding to help Ontario businesses. That’s 0.01 per cent of our GDP, so clearly the program is not working.”

claims.claim: Ghana's energy minister said a 6,000-metric-ton LPG storage terminal was commissioned and MT Asharami Ghana made a first gas delivery.
claims.episode_span: a 6,000-metric-ton liquefied petroleum gas storage terminal has been commissioned and that the vessel MT Asharami Ghana has made a first gas delivery
claims.source_title: Ghana’s minister calls LPG investments key to 2030 target
claims.supporting_quote: In a Facebook post, the minister said that the commissioning of a 6,000-metric-ton LPG storage terminal and the first gas delivery by MT Asharami Ghana demonstrate the importance of private investment for the development of the country’s gas infrastructure.
